messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Russian-language 3D MMORPG-inspired game with raids.

## Requirements
- Build now without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game in one HTML file, using Three.js from jsDelivr.
- Chose a solo raid experience: the player faces the raid boss without multiplayer.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a 3D forest setting, player character, enemies, quest-giver NPC, ancient portal, and raid boss.
- Added movement, combat abilities, enemy AI, health/mana/XP, quest and raid progression, loot, inventory/help modals, minimap, and mobile touch controls.
- JavaScript syntax check passed with `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js`.

### Active
- Validate the game in a browser, fix runtime or visual issues, and capture a small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- Initial browser launch failed because Chromium was not installed; `playwright-cli install-browser chromium` completed successfully, so browser verification can now be retried.

## Next Move
1. Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` and verify the scene renders and gameplay works.
2. Resolve any runtime errors or visual defects; save and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot.
3. Summarize the finished build and note the solo-raid assumption.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/game.js`: Extracted JavaScript used for the syntax check.

## Important Context
- A Python HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Playwright browser installation succeeded; browser verification has not yet been rerun.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Russian-language 3D MMORPG-inspired game with raids.
- Validate the game in a browser and capture a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game in one HTML file, using Three.js from jsDelivr.
- Chose a solo raid experience, with the player facing the raid boss alone.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a Russian-language 3D forest game with movement, combat abilities, enemy AI, quests, progression, loot, inventory/help modals, minimap, and mobile controls.
- Fixed the browser runtime error `ReferenceError: dragging is not defined`.
- Verified the game renders and keyboard movement/combat interaction work; browser console reports no errors.
- Captured and inspected the latest screenshot at `screenshots/game-check.jpg` (1280×800).

Built the playable Russian-language 3D game in `index.html`, with movement, combat, enemy AI, quests, progression, loot, inventory and help screens, a minimap, and mobile controls. The raid is a solo experience, with the player facing the boss alone.

Verified the game in a browser at 1280×800: it renders, movement and combat interaction work, and the browser console shows no errors. The latest screenshot is `screenshots/game-check.jpg`.

Changes are uncommitted.
